Name: Micha, Son of Mephibosheth
Summary: Micha was the young son of Mephibosheth, Jonathan's son, living in Jerusalem when David restored his father's inheritance and set him at the king's table.
KeyStory: Micha grew up in Jerusalem under the shadow of his father's restored place at David's table.
RelatedPeople: Mephibosheth, Son of Jonathan; King David
LifeLesson: A restored father's table feeds his children too.
